verdict.rationale: Browser Use has a dedicated captcha-handling doc page. It states that automatic CAPTCHA solving is on by default for V4 Agent runs and Cloud Browser sessions. It also gives an explicit human fallback: if the challenge remains, open the live preview for human control. Together these are a clear, documented stance rather than silent failure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that solving works, a defined list of which CAPTCHA types are 'supported', and a documented stance for the local open-source library.
